purpose: Source-referenced Lamb-shift correction targets for estimating the missing 1S-2S precision residual after the leading Dirac baseline.

rows.source: Phase-Coherent Measurement of the Hydrogen 1S-2S Transition Frequency with an Optical Frequency Interval Divider Chain
rows.blocker: Requires primary paper/full-table capture and QED/recoil/proton-radius decomposition before validation gating.

rows.source: A critical compilation of experimental data on spectral lines and energy levels of hydrogen, deuterium, and tritium
rows.blocker: Requires term-convention audit, 2P reference convention, and QED/recoil/proton-radius decomposition before validation gating.

handoff_rule.interpretation: Apply only as an empirical residual-sizing handoff after the leading Dirac baseline. This is not a first-principles QED calculation.

claim_boundary: This package can estimate the empirical Lamb-shift gap in the 1S-2S residual, but it does not validate QED, proton-size corrections, hyperfine structure, or UET first-principles atomic theory.
